The '''Bharhulai Tribal Lands''' were a series of territories located in the northern regions of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], extending to the world's polar icecap. The lands were ruled by the [[Bharhulai]] tribe and most outsiders did their best to avoid the territories, due to the Bharhulai's fierce reputation.
